result: Reordered native route filters so mutation authorization/auditing wraps CSRF validation. Added a mapped-endpoint regression proving a CSRF-denied native POST returns 403 and writes a denied audit event.

evidence.outcome: ApiMutationAuthorizationFilter is registered before CsrfFilter for native API routes.
Regression invokes the mapped import POST endpoint and asserts 403 plus denied audit event.
